_comment: Series catalog. polarity: +1 higher reads as stronger/better, -1 higher reads as weaker/riskier, 0 neutral (score measures how unusual the reading is, not direction). transform is what the score's level/z/percentile are computed on: level (the raw value), yoy_pct, mom_pct, or diff (change vs previous observation). Percent changes over 7/30/90/365 days are always reported on the raw value. cross_check groups series from different sources that should agree; a mismatch raises an alert and a risk flag. SEC and openFDA rows are expanded by lib/catalog.js from the templates at the bottom. Excluded on licensing grounds (third-party copyright on FRED): University of Michigan sentiment, LBMA gold, VIX, ICE BofA spreads.

sec._comment: One company facts pull and one submissions pull per company per day. skip_metrics lists concepts a company does not report (confirmed on the first live run, 2026-10-04: banks have no operating income or current assets/liabilities; XOM, PFE, LLY and JNJ do not tag OperatingIncomeLoss; JPM has no framed long-term debt and XOM none after 2017); ratios built on a skipped metric are skipped too. Metrics come from XBRL frames (CYyyyyQn for quarters, CYyyyy for fiscal years, ...I for instants) so every value is the one SEC deduplicated across filings. concepts lists fallbacks in order.
sec._insider_comment: Form 4 open-market purchases (code P) and sales (code S), valued at shares x price per share and summed by filing week. Each Form 4 is read once and remembered (kv sec_form4:<ticker>). Grants, option exercises and tax withholding are not counted.

insider_metrics.label: Insider open-market purchases (Form 4, code P), weekly value
Insider open-market sales (Form 4, code S), weekly value

wikimedia._comment: Wikipedia pageviews (human users, all platforms) and edits of each SEC company's English Wikipedia article (the 'wiki' field), summed into complete weeks. Higher reads as more public attention than usual for that company.

clinicaltrials._comment: ClinicalTrials.gov studies whose lead sponsor matches the company's ctgov_sponsors names. Starts and completions count ACTUAL dates by month; stops count studies now terminated, withdrawn or suspended by the month of their last update; active is a daily snapshot of recruiting or active studies.
